page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, configured with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average multi-core CPU capabilities and memory bandwidth, with cached read bandwidth reaching 389.72 GB/sec and uncached read bandwidth at 48.91 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by lower scores in single-threaded stress-ng, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression tests. Multi-core Geekbench and Redis SET operations also fall into the lower performance tier, indicating potential bottlenecks for highly sequential or throughput-heavy database workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.2xlarge offers a standard resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of memory-optimized or compute-optimized tiers. It is best suited for workloads such as software compilation, text processing, ray tracing, and moderate database operations, where balanced CPU-to-memory ratios are required but extreme single-core throughput is not critical.
